policy.cohort: All MTA-selected routes with DEFINITE_APPLICABLE_SEVERE context at original BASELINE_REPLAY validation/test checkpoints.
policy.confirmation: At least one selected leg has an applicable incident whose contemporaneous official text explicitly assigns severe delays to that leg route and direction.
policy.freshness: Retain FRESH and LAST_OBSERVED as distinct evidence states; text confirmation does not upgrade receipt freshness.
policy.interpretation: An official severe service notice does not prove a particular chosen train incurred a measured severe delay.
policy.mixed_severity: Ordinary-delay routes and directions are not severe merely because another clause names severe impact.
policy.segment_scope: All included severe impact clauses are route-wide; preserve original segment applicability and directional selected-leg evidence.

purpose: Input-only confirmation of severe impact on the actual selected route and direction; supplement to the frozen classifier, not a predictor modification.
review_method: Explicit review of the contemporaneous official text and its route/direction clauses. No outcomes, predicted savings, or recommendation results were used. Rules cover the observed versions only and are not a generic severity classifier.

versions.description:
[N] train service between 36 St (Bklyn) and Coney Island-Stillwell Av has resumed. 
[R] train service between 36 St (Bklyn) and Bay Ridge-95 St has resumed. 
What Happened?
NYPD is conducted an investigation at Bay Ridge Av.

While trains get back on schedule, consider these alternatives:
For service to/from Coney Island-Stillwell Av, consider taking a [D][F][Q] train.

For [N][R] service between 36 St and 59 St, take a B11, B63 or B37 bus.
For [N] service between 59 St and Coney Island-Stillwell Av, take a B64 bus.
For [R] service between 59 St and Bay Ridge-95 St, take a B63 or B70 bus.

For connecting service between [N], [F], and [B][Q] trains along Kings Hwy, take a B82 or B82-SBS bus.
